title: MyNameIsPen's Vanilla+
description: My personal vanilla+ modpack for use with friends. Visual overhaul, optimization, and multiplayer tweaks. Very basic.
body:
Hi! This is my personal modlist I use for survival minecraft. It is very simple, including a visual overhaul, some multiplayer functionality, and a few QOL things like zoom. It also has replay mod and orthocamera for looking at builds/content creation, but that is disabled by default.

Enjoy!
